---
title: "Update GitHub After Adding or Updating Data"
author: "AA"
date: "2026-09-28"
output: html_document
editor_options: 
  chunk_output_type: console
---
```{r}
# Use this whenever you change your code

# STEP 1 — See what changed.
system("git status")

system("git show --stat HEAD")

# STEP 2 — Add .RData to .gitignore
write(".RData", file = ".gitignore", append = TRUE)

# Check the .gitignore
readLines(".gitignore")

# STEP 3 — Stage the updated files
system("git add .")

# STEP 4 — Check what is ready to upload
system("git status")

# STEP 5 — Commit the changes
system('git commit -m "Update differential abundance analysis and data"')

# STEP 6 — Push to GitHub
system("git push origin main")

# STEP 7 — Final check
system("git status")

# STEP 8 — Upload your new commit to GitHub
system("git push origin main")

system("git push")

system("git status")

# STEP 9 — Confirm GitHub is fully updated
system("git status")


system(paste0(
  "git remote set-url origin ",
  "https", "://github.com/AntisarAfkairin/",
  "Vivanco-Lab-Legume-Wheat-Cover-Crop-Microbiome-Project.git"
))

system("git remote -v")
system("git fetch origin")

system("git log --oneline --all --decorate --graph -8")

system("git pull origin main --no-rebase --no-edit")

system("git status")
cat(readLines("README.md"), sep = "\n")

writeLines(
  "# Vivanco Lab – Legume–Wheat Cover Crop Microbiome Project",
  "README.md"
)
system("git add README.md")

system("git status")

system('git commit -m "Merge GitHub README update"')
system("git status")

system("git push")
system("git status")

```
